selectedFunctions.label: Re Protocol Deposit approved collateral for reUSD
warnings: Re Protocol reUSD is 0x5086bf358635B81D8C47C66d1C8b9E567Db70c72 on Ethereum, not Resupply reUSD. sreUSD is Resupply Savings reUSD and is NOT a Re Protocol wrapper; no sreUSD wrap/unwrap is admitted.

Mandatory KYC/AML or KYB, eligible non-US person/permitted jurisdiction, platform agreement and Token Purchase Agreement/fee schedule apply. Registry approval cannot be bypassed. Direct ICL deposit is for already approved callers; this does not implement the app pre-KYC escrow flow.

ICL deposit(token,amount,minShares) pulls the selected registry-enabled ERC20 from caller after ICL approval. amount is raw input-token units (USDC/USDT typically 6; USDe/sUSDe 18), minShares is raw reUSD share units. Tokens and shares are not 1:1; fee and oracle decimal scaling apply. Registry enablement and prices are not freshly attested.

depositNative(minShares) uses msg.value wei, wraps registry.getWrappedNative(), and only works when that token is enabled. It is not evidence that the current app offers native ETH; official mint docs list USDC/USDT/USDe/sUSDe. Reverts for zero value, disabled token/deposits, KYC or pause.

processPrestakedDeposit(token,amount,minShares,receiver) is a typed on-behalf deposit, not a role-only method: caller pays its own funds and the receiver must be KYC-approved. It does not approve the caller/receiver or lift legal eligibility. Verify the intended receiver and obtain token approval to ICL.

Gateway redeemInstant shares is raw reUSD input; minPayout is raw units of the active payout token, not USD-WAD/share units. Gateway delegates transferFrom to InstantRedemption 0xa31deEbb3680A3007120e74bCbDf4df36F042A40: approve that module, not the gateway, for shares. Dynamic active payout token, fee, reserves, per-wallet/daily caps and minimum/maximum amounts apply; preview does not guarantee execution.

Quarterly submit/adjust/cancel work only in WINDOW mode while submission is open and before deadline. Approve WindowRedemption 0xb5930ad554f9da6783a3dd259a111e9d1bd85b75, not gateway. Shares are escrowed; requests cannot be duplicated. Adjust to zero/cancel returns shares before deadline; cancellation itself has no KYC modifier, but share-token restrictions may still apply.

claimWindowPayout(windowId) requires a settled user request, fresh KYC and claim within 30 days after closeTime. Payout uses snapshotted share price at close and payout-token price at settlement with that token decimals; fees apply, fulfilled shares burn, unfulfilled shares return. Partial fulfillment and zero payout are possible; no instant/full redemption guarantee.

Gateway constructor binds the stated instant/window modules, reUSD token, and KYC registry 0x82F1806AEab5Ecb9a485eb041d5Ed4940b123995. Modules are admin-configurable: constructor binding is not a fresh live getter/configuration attestation. Source comment saying approve gateway is contradicted by actual module transferFrom; the module is the spender.

Catalog provenance is document/explorer source evidence only, not fresh RPC bytecode/storage/configuration or successful execution evidence. Pauses, roles, allowances, caps, liquidity and independent execution controls remain authoritative; principal can be lost.

Mandatory KYC/AML or KYB, eligible non-US person/permitted jurisdiction, platform agreement and Token Purchase Agreement/fee schedule apply. Registry approval cannot be bypassed. Direct ICL deposit is for already approved callers; this does not implement the app pre-KYC escrow flow.

ICL deposit(token,amount,minShares) pulls the selected registry-enabled ERC20 from caller after ICL approval. amount is raw input-token units (USDC/USDT typically 6; USDe/sUSDe 18), minShares is raw reUSD share units. Tokens and shares are not 1:1; fee and oracle decimal scaling apply. Registry enablement and prices are not freshly attested.

depositNative(minShares) uses msg.value wei, wraps registry.getWrappedNative(), and only works when that token is enabled. It is not evidence that the current app offers native ETH; official mint docs list USDC/USDT/USDe/sUSDe. Reverts for zero value, disabled token/deposits, KYC or pause.

processPrestakedDeposit(token,amount,minShares,receiver) is a typed on-behalf deposit, not a role-only method: caller pays its own funds and the receiver must be KYC-approved. It does not approve the caller/receiver or lift legal eligibility. Verify the intended receiver and obtain token approval to ICL.

Gateway delegates transferFrom to InstantRedemption 0xa31deEbb3680A3007120e74bCbDf4df36F042A40: approve that module, not the gateway, for shares. Dynamic active payout token, fee, reserves, per-wallet/daily caps and minimum/maximum amounts apply; preview does not guarantee execution.

restrictions.tokenIdentityCorrection: sreUSD belongs to Resupply per its official Savings reUSD docs; Re official token table instead lists reUSD/reUSDe. No identity-compatible official Re sreUSD deployment was found; no wrapper capability is fabricated.
restrictions.units: Deposit token raw decimals; reUSD share/minShares amounts in raw 18-decimal share units (both instant/window constructors enforce shareToken.decimals()==18). minPayout and payouts use active payout token decimals; instant valuation and oracle prices have separate USD-WAD normalization.

gatewayModuleBindings.basis: Etherscan gateway verified constructor arguments; mutable configuration not freshly read

restrictions.claimPeriod: Window source CLAIM_PERIOD = 30 days after closeTime; KYC rechecked at claim; operator settlement and snapshot prices required. Unfulfilled shares are returned.
restrictions.noScopeExpansion: Token parameters are typed deposit registry assets only, not arbitrary execution addresses/calldata. No new runtime execution support or signing bypass is implied.
